text:
emma_sales: Heads-up — FinOpsCo wants a VPC/on‑prem POC. Scope: 3-node Dedicated (k80 equiv), 30d, telemetry + KMS integration test. Asking for platform fee waiver during POC and ability to split invoicing across 2 BU cost centers. Can we do that without escalating to legal?
raj_dealdesk: Need the numbers and binding conditions. What platform fee are they trying to waive and what's the expected commit if they convert? :thinking_face:
liam_se: From infra side: 3 nodes ~ steady 120k tokens/day typical, perf looks like x1.2 qps vs our baseline. KMS test is fine but requires a short extra onboarding window for key provisioning (1–2 days). No blocker.
noah_solutions: Important: on-prem installer will push telemetry by default — customer wants 90d retention in staging only. We can set retention to 30d for POC. Full retention policy change needs Security signoff.
emma_sales: Proposed special terms (customer asks): 1) platform fee waived for POC; 2) if they convert to committed Dedicated within 60d, waive first full month platform fee OR convert POC credits against commit; 3) enable KMS test with limited keys; 4) split invoice 60/40 between BU-A and BU-B.
olivia_finance: Split invoicing is possible but needs PO numbers and separate GL codes up front. Also we require a billing contact per BU and a single payment method — we can then produce two invoices that roll up to one payment if they want. Revenue recognition note: credits applied at conversion means deferred revenue adjustments, will need finance approval.
raj_dealdesk: Conditional approval path: I can approve platform fee waiver for a 30d POC if sales captures: expected commit ($/mo), PO numbers, legal signoff on POC terms (liability cap + data handling), and a restart clause (we revert fee waiver if no conversion in 60d). Add SLA exceptions in writing.
emma_sales: Got it. I'll collect PO numbers and commit estimate. Quick Q: can we express the conversion credit as "apply POC platform fee as a one-time credit against initial month of committed reserved capacity"?
liam_se: Yes technically that's fine. We apply a one-time credit invoice item. Implementation note: use code `POC-CREDIT-<acct>` on the invoice so finance can map it to GL 4101.
olivia_finance: Confirmed — invoice line `POC-CREDIT-<acct>` mapped to product credits bucket. We need the dollar amount explicitly before issuing the credit.
noah_solutions: Security caveat on KMS: we can enable testing with customer-managed keys in staging, but for on‑prem we need either direct HSM access or wrapped keys. Recommend short checklist for security and keys exchange.
deploy-bot: Quote attached: https://redwood.quotes/2143650000 — includes provisional waiver line item and platform fee credit row.
raj_dealdesk: I'll sign off on the waiver if sales attaches the signed POC addendum with the following snippet included: `Platform fee waived for POC; if customer converts to a committed Dedicated plan within 60 days, Redwood will apply a one-time credit equal to the waived platform fee to the first invoice of the committed subscription.` Otherwise no waiver.
emma_sales: I'll send the addendum to the customer today with PO fields + commit estimate. Will ping once returned. :thumbsup:
olivia_finance: Once we have signed addendum and PO numbers, finance will generate split invoices. Expect 24–48h lead time.
liam_se: I'll prepare a short runbook for KMS onboarding and telemetry retention toggles; tagging @noah_solutions to review.
raj_dealdesk: Cool. Please tag me on the final docs. If legal flags anything unusual I'll escalate. :eyes:
emma_sales: Thanks all — moving to thread: will update when signed.
